'''2013 SoCal Grand Prix Day 1 Gabe LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Gabe]] at [[2013 SoCal Grand Prix]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion|Cor-L-pleadmycasetothesenate.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
